> [!IMPORTANT]
> **This release never shipped. Do not install from it, and do not assume you have it.**
>
> No ZIP was ever attached here and nothing was uploaded to the Shopware
> Community Store, so no merchant received 0.1.2. The tag, this page and the
> notes below are the whole of what exists.
>
> **0.1.3 supersedes it and carries everything listed below**, including the
> carve-php 0.1.5 security requirement. Install
> [0.1.3](https://github.com/markup-carve/shopware-carve/releases) instead.

The release object here was created by hand on 2026-08-18, ten hours before the
tagged run started. That run failed at its `Resolve release notes` step, because
`.github/release-notes/0.1.2.md` did not exist yet, and both the store upload and
the publish step were skipped - leaving a published release with a tag, a body
and no artifact, which reads exactly like one that shipped. Nobody noticed for
eight weeks. The page is kept as-is, apart from this note, because the record of
that is worth more than a tidy releases list.

Everything below now ships in 0.1.3.

### Security

- **A list-valued URL attribute is probed at every candidate, not at its head.** `srcset="safe.png 1x, javascript:alert(1) 2x"` passed the probe on its second entry, because the value vouched for itself from its leading scheme. Comes from carve-php 0.1.5, now the required floor. **Upgrade if you render untrusted Carve or import untrusted HTML.**

### Changed

- A list-table header cell renders as `<th scope="col">` rather than a bare `<th>`, which is what a screen reader needs to associate the column. Theme overrides matching on the bare tag need updating.

### Added

- Configurable `:name:` symbol shortcodes with trusted raw-HTML replacement values.
